key_insight: Split-RL uses guidance labels to separate locally conflicting learning signals during tree construction, reducing interference between objectives.
engineering_relevance: It offers a way to incorporate heuristic, sensor-derived, or rule-based guidance into learned policies that must balance reward, constraints, or imitation.
method: Build gradient-boosted tree policies with guidance-aware splits.
Route conflicting updates into disjoint state-space regions before gradient aggregation loses objective-specific information.
Apply local conflict resolution to constrained RL and offline learning from mixed datasets.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports evaluations across spatial, rare-event, and temporal conflicts, with episodic cost-budget compliance and competitive rewards, plus near-expert offline performance across varying dataset sizes.
watch_item: Performance may depend on informative guidance labels; the abstract does not quantify robustness to noisy or unavailable labels.
paper_title: Split-RL: Local Conflict Resolution in Reinforcement Learning
